events.title: Cranked Patch Notes
events.summary: Cranked Update - October 23, 2026 Improvements Replay Editor Video export: new encoder, sharper exports with no dropped frames, exports now work on Mac and Linux Choose where videos and photos save, in Videos and Screenshots folders Export at 30 or 60 fps Camera turns and moves slower when zoomed in, and held scrub speeds up Free camera goes up to 400 mm with no tilt limits, and orbit can go under the bike Keyframes only select when you're exactly on them, and mouse drag scrubs the timeline Bug

events.title: Cranked Demo Update - Patch Notes
events.summary: Cranked Update - October 16, 2026 New Stuff Our first tricks have landed in Cranked! No handers and no footed can can. These are early versions and still a WIP. RB + R stick up (keyboard: Left Ctrl + Space) - no hander RB + R stick right (keyboard: Left Ctrl + Right Arrow) - no footed can can Tricks count for trick challenges and score in the Freeride event Trail Builder: build your own maps in a new in-game editor. Patreon members only for now. Very early test, so expect rough edges and tell us

events.title: Cranked Demo Update - Patch Notes
events.summary: Cranked Update - October 9, 2026 New Stuff New PB Messages setting hides other riders' PB chat lines. World records get their own message and always show. events.title: Steam Playtest Kicking Off Later This Month!
events.summary: Hey everyone! I just wanted to make a quick announcement that we are planning to launch our first free Steam Playtest later this month! Make sure you sign up for the playtest by hitting the signup button on our store page. We plan to release the playtest to everyone who signs up. We hope to launch it before Christmas. It will consist of four trails on our prototype map with the first version of our new environment art that our artist Maggie has been working hard on. We can't wait to get Cranked
